You can view John’s full scholarly presence through the following links: his Baidu Scholar page at https://xueshu.baidu.com/user/abcdef, his GitHub repository at https://github.com/jdoe, his LinkedIn profile at https://www.linkedin.com/in/johndoe, and his Twitter account at https://twitter.com/johndoe. Additional academic profiles are available on ResearchGate (https://www.researchgate.net/profile/John_Doe) and SSRN (https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/cf_dev/AbsByAuth.cfm?per_id=1234567).
